reviews.title: Life changer
reviews.contents:
As a first-time mom, this app helped me organize my 3month baby routine.
It was mind-blowing how accurate it was.

it's been life changer 🥰

reviews.title: Sleep update
reviews.contents: Love the app it really helps but it lately since the new update and the summer offer everytime I go into the app it shows the offer. Then when I hit exit it won’t let me back on to track my babies sleep. Even going in and out of the app. To say it’s a bit annoying is the nice way of putting it.

reviews.title: Buggy!!
reviews.contents:
Often has issues with promotional pop
Ups when you open it. Finnicky-really annoying when you have a baby in your arms.

reviews.title: Remplie de demande d’abonnement
reviews.contents: Je l’aimais jusqu’à ce que l’application me harcèle pour m’abonner

reviews.title: Game changer
reviews.contents: We have been using this for one and a half year and I can only recommend this app

reviews.title: Sleeping through the night
reviews.contents: Amazing app that got us through our 4 month sleep regression and we’ve been using it ever since!

reviews.title: It’s Free and On point
reviews.contents: Honestly just needed something to help me get my child to sleep more regular and this was the app for me. He’s old enough I no longer needed to track feeds and diapers. We struggled so much getting him on a regular sleep schedule and this really helped us get there.

reviews.title: Ok but predictions are way off
reviews.contents: Very easy to track and not overwhelming. But predictions are way off. Not super helpful.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.contents: Great app! Really helped with tracking my babes nap patterns. It really works!!!! My critique would be is that I wish it also predicted her wake cycles at night too!

reviews.title: The best App ever
reviews.contents: This app has been a game-changer for our family! It has helped me understand and track my baby’s sleep routine, making bedtime so much easier and more peaceful. Since using it, my baby sleeps wonderfully, and I feel more confident and organized. I’m truly grateful for the positive difference it has made in our daily routine. I highly recommend it to any parent looking to improve their baby’s sleep!
